subject.title: [Bug]: Slack provider doesn't reliably reload after channels.slack.botToken rotation (cached singleAuthorization)

question: What current-main or newest-release proof is sufficient to choose between watcher hardening and a Control UI/config.patch reload repair for Slack token-string rotation?
rationale: The code and a contributor run support direct-edit restarts, but the reported failure is tied to a container/control-plane path that has not been reproduced; a maintainer needs to decide the proof threshold before automation changes reload behavior.

options.title: Require Container/Control-Plane Repro
options.body: Keep this issue open until a Sandpaw/container or Control UI/config.patch save shows whether the watcher misses the write or the RPC path skips reload scheduling.

options.title: Fold Into Native Rotation Direction
options.body: Treat this as adjacent context for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42747 only if maintainers decide manual token-string reload reliability should not be tracked separately.

options.title: Close Later If Still Unreproducible
options.body: If current-main and newest-release container/control-plane attempts keep showing reliable restarts, close later with cannot-reproduce proof.

recommendation.title: Require Container/Control-Plane Repro
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a Sandpaw/container or Control UI/config.patch save shows whether the watcher misses the write or the RPC path skips reload scheduling.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and latest commenter defining the missing reproduction boundary.
